Message:
I’ve uncovered everything
that makes up this world...

There’s no longer
any question left
worth attaining
greater knowledge for.

Haah... What an utterly
boring world this is...

It’s awfully cliché,
but this never-ending boredom
must be that inescapable
trench they call
“the depths of despair”...

Then, as I was killing time,
the tides turned.
When I looked into
a certain legend...

The legend goes that
around 200 years ago,
a group of heroes saved Derulla
from the verge of ruin.

Normally, such drivel could be
laughed off as nothing more
than a fairy tale...

But, my research led me to
unearth a certain object
from the site where
the legend took place.

It was plant matter unlike any
I had ever laid eyes on—
an unknown “seed.”

I knew from the moment
its shell graced my palm...

that this seed was the very thing
that would finally bring color
to my dull existence...
